Title: Mask of a Thousand Faces questions

Messages.Author: Nosk
Messages.Body:
There are some interactions with Mask of a Thousand Faces that are not clear to me. So I would like to ask about them:

How does this card interact with  Nergal (ADV) ? Nergal makes reactions cost 1 more blood when he is acting. If Nergal declares a bleed, then my prey plays a wake (paying 1 more blood because of Nergal) and tries to block, can I play a Mask with any other minion I control? Or I am not able to do it because of the "Nergal effect" already applied?
Similar as above, but with  Giotto Verducci . If Giotto is acting and a vampire pays 1 blood to try to block, can I then play a Mask with another minion?
If the acting vampire is blocked and then in combat he plays  Form of Mist at superior to continue the action. Can then I play a Mask with another vampire? Does that vampire playing the Mask need to have Protean (I guess so)? And could that "new" acting vampire play another Form of Mist at superior?
Thank you!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:

> There are some interactions with Mask of a Thousand Faces that are not clear to me. So I would like to ask about them:
>
Don't paste images for reference, they can be lost and don't permit to quote text.

> Nosk wrote:
> How does this card interact with  Nergal (ADV) ? Nergal makes reactions cost 1 more blood when he is acting. If Nergal declares a bleed, then my prey plays a wake (paying 1 more blood because of Nergal) and tries to block, can I play a Mask with any other minion I control? Or I am not able to do it because of the "Nergal effect" already applied?
>
You can't Mask.

> Nosk wrote:
> Similar as above, but with  Giotto Verducci . If Giotto is acting and a vampire pays 1 blood to try to block, can I then play a Mask with another minion?
>
You can't Mask.

> Nosk wrote:
> If the acting vampire is blocked and then in combat he plays  Form of Mist at superior to continue the action. Can then I play a Mask with another vampire? Does that vampire playing the Mask need to have Protean (I guess so)?
>
The masking vampire must have superior Protean.

> Nosk wrote:
> And could that "new" acting vampire play another Form of Mist at superior?
>
No, cardtext.

Messages.Body:
> > Nosk wrote:
> > And could that "new" acting vampire play another Form of Mist at superior? [/li]

>
But Form of Mist says "A vampire can play only one Form of Mist at superior each action." In this case, it will be another vampire. Why not?
